properties.title: Mandatory Inclusionary Housing and Zoning for Quality and Affordability adopted
properties.short_description: Affordable unit production tied to rezonings
properties.explanation: Affordable unit production tied to rezonings

properties.title: 10 Hudson Yards opened as the first Hudson Yards tower
properties.short_description: Hudson Yards recorded 10 Hudson Yards officially opening on 31 May 2016 and welcoming the first Coach employees.
properties.explanation: The first occupied tower in the Hudson Yards development entered use on Manhattan's West Side.

properties.title: 425 Grand Concourse development team was selected
properties.short_description: NYC HPD announced on April 28, 2016 the selection of Trinity Financial and MBD Community Housing Corporation to develop 425 Grand Concourse.
properties.explanation: A documented HPD announcement selected a development team for a South Bronx mixed-use affordable-housing project.

properties.title: NYPL 53rd Street Library opened in Midtown
properties.short_description: The New York Public Library recorded the grand opening and ribbon-cutting of its new 53rd Street branch on 27 June 2016.
properties.explanation: A new three-level Midtown public library branch opened in the former Donnell Library replacement site.

properties.title: New York City AIDS Memorial dedicated
properties.short_description: The New York City AIDS Memorial records its official dedication on World AIDS Day, 1 December 2016, with a ribbon-cutting at the Greenwich Village site.
properties.explanation: A permanent public memorial and park element entered civic use on the former St. Vincent's Hospital campus.

properties.title: The Alamo sculpture returned to Astor Place
properties.short_description: NYC DDC announced on 1 November 2016 that The Alamo sculpture had returned to Astor Square after an almost two-year restoration.
properties.explanation: A documented public-art restoration returned the steel cube sculpture to its long-time Astor Place location.

properties.title: Arthur Ashe Stadium retractable roof was unveiled
properties.short_description: USTA coverage recorded the fully operational retractable roof over Arthur Ashe Stadium being officially unveiled in August 2016.
properties.explanation: A large stand-alone retractable roof structure entered use over the existing tennis stadium.

properties.title: Astor Place reconstruction was completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC reported on 16 November 2016 that the Astor Place community enhancement project had been completed with new and expanded pedestrian plazas.
properties.explanation: A documented public-realm reconstruction created and expanded plazas, added planting areas, permeable pavement, curbside rain gardens, and bike racks.

properties.title: Brooklyn Botanic Garden opened the Shelby White and Leon Levy Water Garden
properties.short_description: Brooklyn Botanic Garden recorded a September 15, 2016 member event on the day the Shelby White and Leon Levy Water Garden opened.
properties.explanation: A documented opening or public-use milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: The Beekman reopened as a hotel
properties.short_description: Architectural Record reported in October 2016 that the 19th-century Temple Court office building had reopened as The Beekman hotel.
properties.explanation: A restored 19th-century office building and new residential tower entered hotel, restaurant, bar, and residential use near City Hall.

properties.title: Caribbean Cultural Center African Diaspora Institute opened its East Harlem firehouse home
properties.short_description: An official NYC Department of Cultural Affairs PDF records the October 2016 ribbon-cutting and grand-opening celebration for CCCADI's new home in the landmarked East Harlem firehouse on East 125th Street.
properties.explanation: A documented opening or public-use milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: Compass Residences first two buildings were completed
properties.short_description: NYC HDC announced on November 17, 2016 a ribbon-cutting completion milestone for Compass Residences buildings 1A and 1B at 1490 and 1500 Boone Avenue in the Bronx.
properties.explanation: A documented city and state housing-agency release recorded completion of the first two buildings in a multi-phase residential development.

properties.title: Ford Amphitheater at Coney Island opened
properties.short_description: NY1 reported the Coney Island amphitheater opening with a Ziggy Marley concert in June 2016 as part of the reused Childs Restaurant boardwalk complex.
properties.explanation: A landmark boardwalk restaurant complex entered public event and amphitheater use.

properties.short_description: NYC HDC announced on September 21, 2016 a combined ribbon-cutting and groundbreaking event that included completion of an East New York rental portfolio rehabilitation.
properties.explanation: A documented public release recorded a portfolio rehabilitation completion milestone for occupied affordable housing.

properties.title: East New York rezoning map amendment was adopted
properties.short_description: NYC Council records Resolution 1054-2016 approving C 160035 ZMK on April 20, 2016, a zoning map amendment for the East New York Community Plan.
properties.explanation: A documented zoning map milestone was recorded for the East New York Community Plan area.

properties.title: Eastern Parkway Branch reopened after roof restoration
properties.short_description: NYC DDC announced on 4 April 2016 that Brooklyn Public Library's Eastern Parkway Branch had reopened after roof restoration work.
properties.explanation: A documented Carnegie library renovation restored the limestone roof and added a new roof drainage system.

properties.title: Elmhurst Community Library reopened in Queens
properties.short_description: NYC DDC recorded that Queens Library and city officials cut the ribbon on the new Elmhurst Community Library on 20 December 2016.
properties.explanation: A new four-story branch library entered public use on the Elmhurst library site.

properties.title: EMS Station 50 opened in Jamaica

properties.explanation: A documented 13,000-square-foot emergency medical services station opened with ambulance bays, MERV capacity, locker rooms, kitchen area, and fitness center.

properties.title: Fordham Plaza reconstruction was unveiled
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and NYC DOT announced on 20 January 2016 that the newly reconstructed Fordham Plaza in the Bronx had been unveiled.
properties.explanation: A documented public-realm reconstruction added pedestrian space, seating, kiosks, landscaping, wayfinding, and transit-circulation changes at Fordham Plaza.

properties.title: Gateway Elton Street Phase II completion was announced

properties.explanation: A documented city and state housing-agency release recorded completion of a mixed-use affordable housing phase.

properties.title: The Hills opened on Governors Island
properties.short_description: The Trust for Governors Island opened The Hills, a new designed landscape and public vantage point, in July 2016.
properties.explanation: A new public landscape and topographic park feature entered use on Governors Island.

properties.title: Helen Marshall Cultural Center ceremonially opened
properties.short_description: NYC DDC reported on 19 October 2016 that the Helen Marshall Cultural Center at Queens Borough Hall had ceremonially opened on 27 September 2016.
properties.explanation: A documented courtyard conversion created an atrium cultural and entertainment space with a rear entrance and outdoor plaza.

properties.explanation: An adaptive-reuse advanced-manufacturing and technology workspace entered use inside Brooklyn Navy Yard's Green Manufacturing Center.
